name: strands

frames.best_why: The light ribbon swells into a strong blue-white bulge inside the glass orb.

tagline: A frosted glass orb holding a glowing red-to-blue ribbon of light that swells.
summary: A dark glass sphere with a bright spectral band twisting inside it. It swells and leans as a voice assistant listens or as the pointer moves near it.
appearance: A round dark translucent orb edged with a soft glassy rim, on a black field. A band of light crosses its middle, warm red and orange above a white-hot core and cool blue below; small grey captions sit at the bottom.
behaviour: The band ripples and bulges continuously, guided by a simulated speech level, while its glow and lean respond to a nearby pointer or a click. It settles to a calm hum when listening stops.
demo_content: Captions 'Listening…' and 'Ask about your calendar, notes or inbox'.
search_phrases: glowing sphere for ai voice ui
use_when: A voice or AI assistant needs a focal, ambient indicator that reacts while it listens.
avoid_when: It is a full-size WebGL scene with its own loop, so it is heavy for many instances and needs a sized parent.
customise: Colours, strand count, speed, amplitude, waviness, thickness, glow, taper, spread, refraction, dispersion, glass size, energy, listening and light mode are props.
weight_why: A fragment-shader scene renders every frame at up to 2x device pixel ratio.

a11y.note: The canvas is hidden from assistive tech and carries no status text, so the listening state is only visual.

issues: The demo captions sit outside the component, so the orb arrives with no label or hint.
polish_why: The glass rim and refractive ribbon look rich; the motion is slow and believable.
title: Strands
